substantive_QA_supplier_review.scope: Statements/definitions and proof routes of all direct uses personally read; transitive logical-interface propagation checked through exact dependency closure. Not an independent review of every full QA proof.

confirmed_compatibility.acceptance: QA15 and QA32/QMA sum every unmeasured label; use normalization supplier and charge classical predicate
confirmed_compatibility.diamond: QA34 arbitrary-operator reference norm and factor1/2 preserved; density-only reduction explicitly disallowed
confirmed_compatibility.compiler: QA06 unconditional full-block projective gate counting remains exact-real only; controlled target scalars not erased
confirmed_compatibility.preparation: QA21/22/25/30/34/36 distinguish supplied preparation circuits from explicit table input and exact-real O((n+1)D) gate counts
